t2.title: Companies offer wellness programs to employees
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should companies offer wellness programs to employees?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Employee wellness programs are becoming common in modern workplaces. I strongly believe companies should invest in such initiatives.

Firstly, wellness programs improve employee health. Gym memberships, healthy canteens, and mental health support reduce illness and absenteeism. Healthier employees take fewer sick days, benefiting both individuals and organizations.

Secondly, these programs boost productivity and morale. Employees who feel cared for are more engaged and loyal. Stress management workshops help workers cope with pressure, improving performance.

However, critics argue wellness programs are costly and may not show immediate returns. Additionally, some employees may feel pressured to participate.

Nevertheless, research shows return on investment is positive long-term. Reduced healthcare costs and lower staff turnover save money. Programs should be voluntary to avoid pressure.

Furthermore, wellness programs help attract top talent. Young professionals increasingly value work-life balance when choosing employers.

In conclusion, corporate wellness programs benefit everyone. Companies should view them as investments in their most valuable asset – their people.

t2.sampleB1: I think companies should have wellness programs for their employees. It's a good idea because it can help people be healthier. For example, if a company offers gym memberships, more people might exercise. Also, it can make people feel happier at work. If they have less stress, they will probably work better. However, some people might not want to do the wellness programs, and that's okay. But I think it's a good thing for companies to offer them. It could make a big difference to the health and happiness of the workers. In my opinion, it's a worthwhile investment.
t2.sampleB2: What a great question — this is something I've thought about a lot, so I'll happily throw in my opinion. For me, it's a resounding yes. Companies absolutely should offer wellness programs, and honestly, everyone comes out ahead. Let's face it: when people are stressed and burnt out, their work takes a hit. Something as simple as a gym membership or a weekly yoga class can make a world of difference to how staff feel from one day to the next. In my experience, employees who feel looked after tend to be more motivated and far less likely to jump ship. Sure, these programs cost money upfront, but they usually pay for themselves in the long run through fewer sick days and lower staff turnover. That said, I don't think anyone should be forced to take part. The trick is to offer plenty of options and let people choose what works for them. At the end of the day, healthy, happy employees are what keep a business ticking over. Companies that ignore this are missing a trick, if you ask me. Has anyone here had a good — or bad — experience with one? I'd love to hear your thoughts!
t2.uzSample:
Xodimlarning sog'lig'ini yaxshilash dasturlari zamonaviy ish joylarida keng tarqalmoqda. Men kompaniyalar bunday tashabbuslarga sarmoya kiritishi kerak, deb qat'iy ishonaman.

Birinchidan, sog'lomlashtirish dasturlari xodimlarning salomatligini yaxshilaydi. Sport zallariga a'zolik, sog'lom ovqatlanish joylari va ruhiy salomatlikni qo'llab-quvvatlash kasallik va davomatning kamayishiga olib keladi. Sog'lom xodimlar kamroq kasal bo'lishadi, bu ham shaxslar, ham tashkilotlar uchun foydali.

Ikkinchidan, bu dasturlar unumdorlik va kayfiyatni oshiradi. O'ziga g'amxo'rlik qilinganini his qilgan xodimlar ko'proq jalb qilinadi va sodiq bo'ladi. Stressni boshqarish bo'yicha seminarlar xodimlarga bosimga bardosh berishga yordam beradi va ish faoliyatini yaxshilaydi.

Biroq, tanqidchilar sog'lomlashtirish dasturlari qimmatga tushadi va darhol foyda keltirmasligi mumkin, deb ta'kidlaydilar. Bundan tashqari, ba'zi xodimlar ishtirok etishga majbur bo'lishi mumkin.

Shunga qaramay, tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, investitsiyalarning qaytarilishi uzoq muddatda ijobiydir. Sog'liqni saqlash xarajatlarining kamayishi va xodimlarning almashinuvi past bo'lishi pulni tejaydi. Bosimni oldini olish uchun dasturlar ixtiyoriy bo'lishi kerak.

Bundan tashqari, sog'lomlashtirish dasturlari eng yaxshi iste'dodlarni jalb qilishga yordam beradi. Yosh mutaxassislar ish beruvchilarni tanlashda ish va hayot muvozanatini tobora ko'proq qadrlashadi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, korporativ sog'lomlashtirish dasturlari hamma uchun foydali. Kompaniyalar ularni eng qimmatli aktivlariga - o'z xodimlariga sarmoya sifatida ko'rishlari kerak.

Misol uchun, agar kompaniya sport zaliga a'zolikni taklif qilsa, ko'proq odamlar mashq qilishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, bu odamlarni ishda baxtliroq his qilishiga olib kelishi mumkin. Agar ularda stress kamroq bo'lsa, ular ehtimol yaxshiroq ishlashadi. Biroq, ba'zi odamlar sog'lomlashtirish dasturlarini xohlashmasligi mumkin va bu yaxshi. Lekin menimcha, kompaniyalar ularni taklif qilishi yaxshi narsa. Bu ishchilarning salomatligi va baxtiga katta ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin. Mening fikrimcha, bu arzirli sarmoya.
t2.uzSampleB2:
So‘nggi paytlarda kompaniyalar o‘z xodimlari uchun sog‘lomlashtirish dasturlarini taqdim etishi kerakmi yoki yo‘qmi degan savol ko‘p muhokama qilinmoqda va menimcha, bu muhim masala. Xodimlarning farovonligiga sarmoya kiritish ham shaxs, ham tashkilot uchun sezilarli foyda keltirishi mumkin.

Birinchidan, sog‘lomlashtirish dasturlari xodimlarning salomatligini yaxshilashi va ishga kelmaslikni kamaytirishi mumkin. Sport zaliga a'zolik, sog'lom ovqatlanish imkoniyatlari va stressni boshqarish bo'yicha seminarlar kabi resurslarni taklif qilish orqali kompaniyalar sog'lom turmush tarzini rag'batlantirishi mumkin. Bu, o'z navbatida, kasallik tufayli o‘tkazib yuborilgan kunlar sonining kamayishiga va unumdorlikning oshishiga olib kelishi mumkin.

Ikkinchidan, ushbu dasturlar xodimlarning ruhiyatini va ishtiyoqini oshirishi mumkin. Xodimlar ish beruvchisi ularning farovonligi haqida qayg'urayotganini his qilsalar, ular o'z ishlariga ko'proq motivatsiya va sodiqlik bilan yondashadilar. Bu esa yanada ijobiy va samarali ish muhitiga olib kelishi mumkin. Bunday dasturlarni amalga oshirish narxi bilan bog'liq xavotirlar bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, uzoq muddatli foyda, masalan, sog'liqni saqlash xarajatlarining kamayishi va xodimlarning ishda qolish darajasining yaxshilanishi ko'pincha dastlabki sarmoyadan ustun turadi. Shuning uchun, menimcha, bu oqilona qadamdir.

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the yoga studio. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear ZenFlow Team, Thank you for asking about my experience at your yoga studio. I am extremely pleased with my membership. Your instructors are incredibly skilled and create a welcoming atmosphere for all levels. The studio space is peaceful and beautifully designed. My flexibility and stress levels have improved significantly. However, I have some suggestions. The class schedule lacks evening options after 8pm for working professionals. Additionally, the changing rooms are rather small during peak hours. I would appreciate meditation workshops and mindfulness sessions. A yoga retreat program would attract dedicated practitioners. Also, offering online classes would help members practice at home. Overall, ZenFlow has transformed my wellbeing. Yours sincerely, Nigora Salimova
t12.sampleA1:
Hi ZenFlow!

Yoga good. I like yoga. Teachers good. Studio good. I want more yoga!

Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Dear ZenFlow Team,

Thank you for the email. I like the yoga. The teachers are nice and the studio is good. I like the classes, but I want more classes in the evening because I work in the day. And maybe you can have a cafe. I like tea.

Thank you,
Nigora Salimova
t12.sampleB1:
Dear ZenFlow Team,

Thank you for your email. I am writing to tell you what I think about the yoga studio. I like the instructors very much, they are very helpful. The studio is also a nice place to relax.

However, I think you could improve some things. For example, it would be good to have more classes on weekends. Also, I think the prices are a little high. Maybe you could offer discounts for students?

I would also like to see some different kinds of classes, like maybe a class for beginners. Overall, I am happy with the studio.

Sincerely,
Nigora Salimova
t12.sampleB2: Dear ZenFlow Team, Thank you for your kind welcome and for taking the time to ask about my experience so far. On the whole, I've been thoroughly impressed. Your instructors are wonderfully patient and go the extra mile to make newcomers feel at home, whatever their level. The studio itself is calm and spotlessly clean, and I always walk out feeling recharged. That said, I'd like to put forward a couple of suggestions. It would be marvellous if you could lay on more evening classes, since those of us who work full-time find it tricky to attend during the day. In addition, a few meditation workshops would round off your timetable nicely. All in all, joining ZenFlow was one of the best decisions I've made. I look forward to many more sessions. Yours faithfully, Bekzod Aliyev

Hurmat bilan, Nigora Salimova
